canonical_project: Data Center de l'Administration Publique (national public-administration data centre)
owner: Government of the Union of the Comoros - ANADEN (Agence Nationale de Developpement du Numerique) and Comores Cables S.A. (co-managed); AfDB PADEC financing (P-KM-G00-001)
notes: Confirmed national/public facility (Grande Comore, Moroni area; exact commune/address not public). ANADEN official Realisations page (A-grade) states ANADEN and Comores Cables announced inauguration of the Data Center de l'Administration Publique on 19 May 2025, under President Azali Assoumani and the Minister of Posts/Telecom/Digital Economy; purpose: secure hosting, centralisation and backup of public data, IT-resource mutualisation, service resilience; supports national DNS, digital identity and e-service portals (Comores Numerique 2028 / Plan Comores Emergent). Comores Cables now markets advanced data-management and hosting solutions from its datacenter (comorescables.km, A-grade company statement). Press reports (Agence Ecofin 2025-05-14; Dig Watch) add claimed Tier 3 and '44.4 Tb' hosting capacity - unit ambiguous as published; Tier-3 is self-declared, NO TIA-942/EPI/Uptime certification entry found for Comoros. No MW capacity disclosed (capacity_mw null).
